trends.what: A curated list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a one-stop reference for developers looking to quickly integrate third-party data and services without building from scratch.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in math, programming, and computer science.
trends.why: It remains a go-to resource for self-taught developers and career switchers, especially with the growing demand for accessible tech education.

trends.what: A massive collection of freely available programming books, tutorials, and learning resources across many languages and topics.
trends.why: It democratizes access to high-quality technical knowledge, making it a favorite among budget-conscious learners and educators.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your always-available digital helper.
trends.why: It's trending because it promises cross-platform AI autonomy, appealing to users who want a self-hosted alternative to cloud assistants.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps and guides that help developers navigate career growth and skill-building paths.
trends.why: It's trending as developers seek structured, visual guidance to keep up with rapidly evolving tech stacks and job requirements.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents behave like a lazy senior developer, optimizing for minimal code and maximum efficiency.
trends.why: It's trending because it humorously addresses the real-world desire for AI that writes less, simpler, and more maintainable code.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive terminal user interface (TUI) and harness for running coding agents.
trends.why: It's trending for its novel, immersive developer experience that blends terminal power with GUI-like interactivity.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs large mixture-of-experts (MoE) AI models on existing hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It's trending because it makes frontier AI models accessible on consumer hardware, reducing the need for expensive GPUs.
